input.summary: T-1 asks for a CSV export of the ticket list so users can take ticket data out of the app. The ticket gives only the goal. It does not say which fields to include, whether the export covers the filtered view or all tickets, where the trigger lives, or how large exports should be handled. Scope and trigger are the main gaps to close before implementation.
